sources.summary: Anthology ASEAN Architecture Festival 2026: Shared Ground Architecture of Care, Culture, and Collective Futures October 2–4, 2026 · Intramuros, Manila, Philippines I. Leading ASEAN Voices in Architecture is coming to Intramuros for Shared Ground Ground, in Southeast Asia, has never been neutral. It bends under monsoon rain, shifts with reclaimed coastlines, and carries the layered memory of settlements, colonial grids, and postwar cities built one on top of another. This is the premise the Anthology ASEAN Architecture Festival 2026 opens with: that the terrain our region builds on is shared, climatically, historically, and socially, whether we choose to acknowledge it or not.
